mapper.sql: id, product_code, product_name, product_kind, purchase_kind, explore_capacity, fulfillment_route, ticket_id, sale_city, parent_product_id, cash_price, points_price, validity_kind, valid_days, fixed_valid_from, fixed_valid_to, seat_count, gift_allowed, gift_claim_days, status, sale_start_at, sale_end_at, terms_version, revision, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from marketing_product where id = #{id} for update
select id, product_id, topic_id, topic_title, content_revision, sort_no, create_time from marketing_product_item where product_id = #{productId} order by sort_no asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into marketing_product (product_code, product_name, product_kind, purchase_kind, explore_capacity, fulfillment_route, ticket_id, sale_city, parent_product_id, cash_price, points_price, validity_kind, valid_days, fixed_valid_from, fixed_valid_to, seat_count, gift_allowed, gift_claim_days, status, sale_start_at, sale_end_at, terms_version, revision, create_time, update_time) values (#{productCode}, #{productName}, #{productKind}, #{purchaseKind}, #{exploreCapacity}, #{fulfillmentRoute}, #{ticketId}, #{saleCity}, #{parentProductId}, #{cashPrice}, #{pointsPrice}, #{validityKind}, #{validDays}, #{fixedValidFrom}, #{fixedValidTo}, #{seatCount}, #{giftAllowed}, #{giftClaimDays}, #{status}, #{saleStartAt}, #{saleEndAt}, #{termsVersion}, #{revision}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert into marketing_product_item (product_id, topic_id, topic_title, content_revision, sort_no, create_time) values (#{productId}, #{topicId}, #{topicTitle}, #{contentRevision}, #{sortNo}, #{createTime})
